title: Coral Tissue and Skeleton DNA Extraction
author: Molly A Moynihan
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bi9bkh2n

steps.title: Prepare lysozyme stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 12.5 mg lysozyme powder (≥ 40,000 U/mg) in 1 mL nuclease‑free water to make a 12.5 mg/mL solution; aliquot and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Decontaminate work area
steps.instruction: Clean all surfaces and pipettes with 10 % bleach followed by 70 % ethanol.

steps.title: Add coral sample to bead tubes
steps.instruction: Add 200–400 µL air‑brushed coral tissue or 200–500 cm³ pulverized skeleton to each bead tube (adjust amount based on PBS volume, endolithic content, and coral species).

steps.title: Warm MBL solution
steps.instruction: Warm the MBL solution to 65 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add MBL and FB buffers
steps.instruction: Add 350 mL warm MBL solution to each bead tube, then add 100 µL solution FB and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Add lysozyme and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL lysozyme (12.5 mg/mL) to each tube and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL proteinase‑K (20 mg/mL) to each tube and incubate at 65 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Bead‑beat the sample
steps.instruction: Place tubes on a vortex adapter and bead‑beat for 15 minutes.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Add IRS solution and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL solution IRS, vortex briefly, then incubate at 4 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes again at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Avoiding the pellet, transfer all supernatant to a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Add MR solution
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL solution MR, vortex briefly; if MR has precipitated, warm at 55 °C for 5–10 minutes before use.

steps.title: Load supernatant onto spin column
steps.instruction: Load 650 µL of supernatant onto an MB spin column, centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute, discard flow‑through, and repeat until all supernatant is processed.

steps.title: Place column in clean tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the MB spin column into a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Add PW solution
steps.instruction: Add 650 µL solution PW, then centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Ethanol wash step one
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through, add 650 µL ethanol, and centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Ethanol wash step two
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through and centrifuge again at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 2 minutes to remove residual ethanol.

steps.title: Transfer column basket
steps.instruction: Place the MB spin column basket into a clean 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA with water
steps.instruction: Add 60–100 µL nuclease‑free water to the center of the membrane, ensure the membrane is fully wet, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13 000 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute, then discard the spin column.

steps.title: Quantify and store DNA
steps.instruction: Quantify DNA, dilute with nuclease‑free water if needed, and store at –20 °C for short‑term (≤ 1 week) or –80 °C for long‑term storage.
